freshSolves.method: Fresh automatic mask solves. Frames fixed before fitting. Checker strategy replaces the band; weighted strategy retains the original mask with zero band weights. Exported controls are independently rendered with resvg. Geometric and paper checks remain enabled. Variants swap both colours, translate by one source pixel in both axes with background fill, or alter only zero-weight pixels; the protected frame stays fixed.

browserCriteria: Fresh real upload, free-border controls, actual worker strict geometry and paper checks, exact common spans retained on both editable SVG sheets, editor crossing checks, star PDF download. Source-resolution editable disagreement <=0.5% for small hat/house, <=1% top hats, <=3% other free motifs and Hunodan, <=1.5% star. Historical 200-cell score retained separately.

phase.test: free-border house recovers its exact valid topology
phase.result: Old initialization fails to produce a topology in 2.5 seconds; new initializer passes the independently rendered exact house.

resize.test: uploaded hat/house keep compact boundaries after resizing
resize.result: Old initializer retains more than 64 segments in both phases.

hunodan.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately.

limitations: Finite heuristic topology search, not a global optimum.
A different source resolution changes raster edges; both source-resolution and legacy 200-cell browser scores are retained.
Editable conversion can slightly change unshared geometry while retaining exact shared spans.
Browser initialization may take long enough to skip topology and use the legal direct fallback; Node ten-second timing results are not browser timing guarantees.
No physical cutting or assembly test.
